children.text: tatra snānādikartavyānapekṣayaiva pūrṇānandaviśrāntyaiva labdhaśuddhiḥ prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃviddehaikībhāvaṃ bhāvayitvā saṃvidaś ca paramaśivarūpatvāt saptaviṃśativāraṃ mantram uccārya mūrdhavaktrahṛdguhyamūrtiṣu anulomavilomābhyāṃ viśvādhvaparipūrṇatā parameśvare aparatve parāparatve paratve 'pi ca // AbhTs_22.9
children.translated_text: Therein, having obtained purification through resting in full bliss itself, independent of the need for bathing and other [preliminary rites], having first contemplated the unification of breath, awareness, and body, and — since awareness has the nature of the supreme <s>Śiva</s> — having uttered the <s>mantra</s> twenty-seven times in the head, face, heart, secret [center], and form, both in forward and reverse order, the fullness of the entire course [of emanation is established] in the Supreme Lord — in the non-supreme, the supreme-and-non-supreme, and even in the supreme. [AbhTs 22.9]

children.text: tathāhi māyāpuṃprakṛtiguṇadhīprabhṛti dharāntaṃ saptaviṃśatitattvāni kalādīnāṃ tatraiva antarbhāvāt vidyāśaktāv api parāparatve brahmapañcakasya sadyastvājātatvabhavodbhavatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ saptaviṃśatirūpatvam eva uktaṃ śrīmallakuleśādipādaiḥ // AbhTs_22.10
children.translated_text: For thus, the twenty-seven <s>tattvas</s> (principles) from <s>Māyā</s>, <s>Puruṣa</s>, <s>Prakṛti</s>, <s>Guṇas</s>, intellect, and so forth down to earth — since <s>Kalā</s> and others are included therein. Even in the supreme-and-non-supreme of the <s>Vidyā</s> power, the twenty-seven-fold nature of the <s>Brahma</s>-pentad's properties — <s>Sadyojāta</s>, <s>Ajāta</s>, emerging-from-existence, and the like — has been stated by the blessed <s>Lakuleśa</s> and other masters. [AbhTs 22.10]

children.text: paratve 'pi pañcaśaktiḥ hi parameśvaraḥ pratiśakti ca pañcarūpatā evaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ śaktayaḥ tāś ca anyonyam anudbhinnavibhāgā ity ekā śaktiḥ sā cānudbhinnavibhāgā ity evaṃ saptaviṃśatirūpayā vyāptyā saṃvidagneḥ śikhāṃ buddhiprāṇarūpāṃ sakṛduccāramātreṇaiva baddhāṃ kuryāt yena paramaśiva eva pratibaddhā tantrātiriktaṃ na kiṃcid abhidhāvati tathāvidhabuddhyadhiṣṭhitakaraṇacakrānuvedhena purovartino yāgadravyagṛhadigādhārādīn api tanmayībhūtān kuryāt tato 'rghapātram api śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūrayet pūjayec ca tadvipruḍbhiḥ sthaṇḍilāny api tadrasena vāmānāmāṅguṣṭhayogāt dehacakreṣu mantracakraṃ pūjayet tarpayet ca tataḥ prāṇāntaḥ tataḥ sthaṇḍile triśūlātmakaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet māyāntaṃ hi sārṇe aukāre ca śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet māyāntaṃ hi sārṇe aukāre ca śaktitrayāntaṃ tadupari yājyā vimarśarūpā śaktiḥ ity evaṃ sakṛd uccāreṇaiva ādhārādheyanyāsaṃ kṛtvā tatraiva ādheyabhūtāyām api saṃvidi viśvaṃ paśyet tad api ca saṃvinmayam ity evaṃ viśvasya saṃvidā tena ca tasyāḥ saṃpuṭībhāvo bhavati saṃvida uditaṃ tatraiva paryavasitaṃ yato viśvaṃ vedyāc ca saṃvit udeti tatraiva ca viśrāmyati iti etāvattvaṃ saṃvittattvaṃ saṃpuṭībhāvadvayāt labhyate // AbhTs_22.11
children.translated_text: Even in the supreme, the Supreme Lord has five powers; and each power has a fivefold nature — thus there are twenty-five powers. And these, being of undivided distinction from one another, constitute one power; and that, being of undivided distinction — thus through the pervasion of twenty-seven-fold nature, one should bind the flame of the fire of awareness, which has the form of intellect and breath, by a single utterance alone. By this, bound to the supreme <s>Śiva</s> alone, [the fire] does not rush toward anything beyond the <s>tantra</s>. Through the penetration of the circle of instruments presided over by such an intellect, one should make even the worship substances, dwelling, directions, and supports that are before one pervaded by that [awareness]. Then one should fill the oblation-vessel (<s>arghapātra</s>) too through the pervasion of flame-binding, and worship; and with its drops, [one should worship] the altars too. With the juice of that, through the union of the left ring-finger and thumb, one should worship the <s>mantra</s>-circle in the body-centers and make satisfaction-offerings. Then within the breath; then on the altar one should establish the seat of trident-nature, culminating in the triad of powers. For [the seat] extends to <s>Māyā</s>, with the <s>ūrṇa</s> and in the <s>au</s>-vowel, culminating in the triad of powers; above that is the deity to be worshipped, the power of reflective awareness. Thus, by a single utterance alone, having performed the placement (<s>nyāsa</s>) of support and supported, one should see the universe in that very awareness which is the supported. And that too is of the nature of awareness — thus the universe becomes enveloped (<s>saṃpuṭībhāva</s>) by awareness, and awareness by it. Since the universe arises from awareness and comes to rest in that very [awareness], and awareness arises from the knowable and rests in that very [knowable] — this much is the reality of awareness, obtained from the twofold enveloping. [AbhTs 22.11]

children.text: tad uktam sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya iti // AbhTs_22.12
children.translated_text: As it is said: 'Having enveloped the creation...' [AbhTs 22.12]

children.text: tato gandhadhūpāsavakusumādīn ātmaprahvībhāvāntān arpayitvā svaviśrāntyā japtvā upasaṃhṛtya jale nikṣipet // AbhTs_22.13
children.translated_text: Then, having offered incense, perfume, liquor, flowers, and the like, culminating in one's own prostration, having recited [the <s>mantra</s>] through one's own repose, having withdrawn, one should cast [the offerings] into water. [AbhTs 22.13]

children.text: iti bāhyayāgaḥ // AbhTs_22.14
children.translated_text: Thus [ends] the external worship (<s>bāhyayāga</s>). [AbhTs 22.14]

children.text: atha śaktau tatra anyonyaṃ śaktitālāsāvīrāṇām ubhayeṣām ubhayātmakatvena prollāsaprārambhasṛṣṭyantaśivaśaktiprabodhe parasparaṃ vyāpārāt parameśaniyatyā ca śuddharūpatayā tatra prādhānyam etena ca viśiṣṭacakrasyāpi śaktitvaṃ vyākhyātam tatra śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūjanaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ koṇatraye madhye visargaśaktiḥ iti tu vyāptau viśeṣaḥ // AbhTs_22.15
children.translated_text: Now, in the <s>Śakti</s> (consort): therein, of both the <s>śaktis</s> and <s>vīras</s>, because of the mutual bi-natured quality, in the mutual activity of the awakening of <s>Śiva</s>-<s>Śakti</s> beginning from the commencement of the first upsurge up to the end of creation, and because of the necessity of the Supreme Lord, the purity of form takes precedence therein. And by this, the <s>śakti</s>-nature of even the distinguished <s>cakra</s> is explained. Therein, the worship is through the pervasion of flame-binding alone; the seat culminates in the triad of powers; in the center of the three corners is the power of emission (<s>visarga</s>) — this is the specific distinction in the pervasion. [AbhTs 22.15]

children.text: evaṃ svadehe tatraiva cakre tato brahmarandhrādyanucakreṣu // AbhTs_22.16
children.translated_text: Similarly in one's own body — therein in the [primary] <s>cakra</s>, then in the subsidiary <s>cakras</s> from the <s>brahmarandhra</s> (crown aperture) and below. [AbhTs 22.16]

children.text: atha yāmale śakter lakṣaṇam etat tadvad abhedas tato 'napekṣya vayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Now, in the <s>yāmala</s> (paired): the characteristic of the <s>Śakti</s> is this — just like that [previously described], there is non-difference; therefore, disregarding age,

children.text: jātyādīṃś cāsaṅgāt loketarayugalajaṃ hi tādātmyam // AbhTs_22.17
children.translated_text: Caste, and such, because of non-attachment — for the identity born from the union belongs to this world and the other. [AbhTs 22.17]

children.text: kāryahetusahotthatvāt traidhaṃ sākṣād athānyathā /
children.translated_text: Because of arising together as cause and effect, [the union is] threefold — directly or otherwise;

children.text: kḷptāvato mitho 'bhyarcya tarpyānandāntikatvataḥ // AbhTs_22.18
children.translated_text: Having been arranged, mutually worshipping and satisfying, because of being near to bliss. [AbhTs 22.18]

children.text: cakram arcet tadaucityād anucakraṃ tathānugam /
children.translated_text: One should worship the <s>cakra</s>; because of its propriety, the subsidiary <s>cakra</s> follows accordingly;

children.text: bahiḥ puṣpādināntaś ca gandhabhuktyāsavādibhiḥ // AbhTs_22.19
children.translated_text: Externally with flowers and the like, and internally with fragrance, enjoyment, liquor, and the like. [AbhTs 22.19]

children.text: evam ānandasaṃdohitatacceṣṭocchalatsthitiḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus, the state of overflowing with the mass of bliss, with its gestures surging forth;

children.text: anucakragaṇaś cakratādātmyād abhilīyate // AbhTs_22.20
children.translated_text: The group of subsidiary <s>cakras</s>, through identity with the [main] <s>cakra</s>, dissolves [into it]. [AbhTs 22.20]

children.text: nijanijabhogābhogapravikāsamayasvarūpaparimarśe /
children.translated_text: In the reflective awareness of one's own true nature as the expansion of the fullness of one's own enjoyment,

children.text: kramaśo 'nucakradevyaḥ saṃviccakraṃ hi madhyamaṃ yānti // AbhTs_22.21
children.translated_text: Progressively the subsidiary <s>cakra</s> goddesses enter the middle awareness-<s>cakra</s>. [AbhTs 22.21]

children.text: anucakradevatātmakamarīcigaṇapūraṇādhigatavīryam /
children.translated_text: Having obtained power through the filling with the host of rays that are the subsidiary <s>cakra</s> deities,

children.text: tacchaktitadvadātmakam anyonyasamunmukhaṃ bhavati // AbhTs_22.22
children.translated_text: That [main <s>cakra</s>], having the nature of its <s>Śakti</s> and likewise of itself, becomes mutually face-to-face. [AbhTs 22.22]

children.text: tadyugalamūrdhvadhāmapraveśasaspandajātasaṃkṣobham /
children.translated_text: That pair, agitated by the vibration of entry into the upper abode,

children.text: kṣubhnāty anucakrāṇy api tāni tadā tanmayāni na pṛthak tu // AbhTs_22.23
children.translated_text: Also agitates the subsidiary <s>cakras</s>; those then are pervaded by it, not separate. [AbhTs 22.23]

children.text: itthaṃ yāmalam etad galitabhidāsaṃkathaṃ yadaiva tadā /
children.translated_text: Thus, when this <s>yāmala</s> (pairing) is freed from the suspicion of division, then

children.text: kramatāratamyayogāt saiva hi saṃvidvisargasaṃghaṭṭaḥ // AbhTs_22.24
children.translated_text: Through the gradation of sequence, that itself is the collision of the emission of awareness (<s>saṃvid-visarga-saṃghaṭṭa</s>). [AbhTs 22.24]

children.text: taddhruvadhāmānuttaram ubhayātmakajagad udāram ānandam /
children.translated_text: That fixed, supreme, unsurpassed abode — the magnificent bliss of the world that is of both natures,

children.text: no śāntaṃ nāpy uditaṃ śāntoditasūtikāraṇaṃ paraṃ kaulam // AbhTs_22.25
children.translated_text: Neither quiescent nor arisen — the cause of what is quiescent-and-arisen — that is the supreme <s>Kaula</s>. [AbhTs 22.25]

children.text: anavacchinnapadepsus tāṃ saṃvidam ātmasātkuryāt /
children.translated_text: One who desires the unlimited state should make that awareness one's own;

children.text: śāntoditātmakadvayam atha yugapad udeti śaktiśaktimatoḥ // AbhTs_22.26
children.translated_text: Then both — the quiescent-arisen duality of <s>Śakti</s> and <s>Śaktimān</s> — arise simultaneously. [AbhTs 22.26]

children.text: svātmānyonyāveśāt śāntānyatve dvayor dvayātmatvāt /
children.translated_text: Through the mutual interpenetration of each other's Self, because of the duality of both when the otherness is quiescent,

children.text: śaktis tu tadvad uditāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṇāti no tadvān // AbhTs_22.27
children.translated_text: <s>Śakti</s> nourishes the arisen creation as such, but not the possessor of <s>Śakti</s>. [AbhTs 22.27]

children.text: tasyāṃ cāryaṃ kulam atha tayā nṛṣu proktayogasaṃghaṭṭān /
children.translated_text: And therein, the noble <s>kula</s> (lineage); and through the union-collisions of <s>yoga</s> taught by her among humans —

children.text: atha sṛṣṭe dvitaye 'smin śāntoditadhāmni ye 'nusaṃdadhate // AbhTs_22.28
children.translated_text: Then, in this created duality, those who unify in the abode of the quiescent-arisen — [AbhTs 22.28]

children.text: prācyāṃ visargasattām anavacchidite pade rūḍhāḥ /
children.translated_text: Established in the prior existence of emission in the unlimited state,

children.text: uditaṃ ca mitho vaktrān mukhyād vaktre pragṛhyate ca bahiḥ // AbhTs_22.29
children.translated_text: And the arisen [is received] from one another's mouth; from the primary, it is taken in externally at the mouth. [AbhTs 22.29]

children.text: tṛptaṃ devīcakraṃ siddhijñānāpavargadaṃ bhavati /
children.translated_text: The satisfied goddess-<s>cakra</s> becomes the bestower of <s>siddhis</s> (powers), knowledge, and liberation;

children.text: śāntābhyāse śāntaṃ śivam eti yad atra devatācakram // AbhTs_22.30
children.translated_text: Through the practice of quiescence, the quiescent deity-<s>cakra</s> attains <s>Śiva</s>. [AbhTs 22.30]

children.text: śūnyaṃ nirānandamayaṃ nirvṛtinijadhāmato 'rghaṃ ca /
children.translated_text: The void, filled with the bliss of voidness (<s>nirānanda</s>), the <s>argha</s> (offering) from the abode of one's own bliss of cessation,

children.text: raṇaraṇakarasān nijarasabharitabahirbhāvacarvaṇarasena // AbhTs_22.31
children.translated_text: With the juice of savoring the external state filled with one's own essence, resonating — [AbhTs 22.31]

children.text: āntarapūrṇasamucchaladanucakraṃ yāti cakram atha tad api /
children.translated_text: The internally full, overflowing subsidiary <s>cakra</s> enters the [main] <s>cakra</s>; and that too

children.text: ucchalati prāgvad iti trividho 'nvartho visargo 'yam // AbhTs_22.32
children.translated_text: Overflows as before — thus this threefold emission (<s>visarga</s>) has its meaning fulfilled. [AbhTs 22.32]

children.text: etad visargadhāmani parimarśanatas tridhaiva manuvīryam /
children.translated_text: By reflective awareness at this abode of emission, the <s>mantra</s>-power is threefold;

children.text: tattatsaṃvidgarbhe mantras tattatphalaṃ sūte // AbhTs_22.33
children.translated_text: The <s>mantra</s>, within the womb of the respective awareness, produces the respective fruit. [AbhTs 22.33]

children.text: koṇatrayāntarāśritanityoditamaṅgalacchade kamale /
children.translated_text: In the lotus with the eternally arisen auspicious covering, situated within the three corners,

children.text: nityāviyutaṃ nālaṃ ṣoḍaśadalakamalasanmūlam // AbhTs_22.34
children.translated_text: The eternally united stalk, rooted in the sixteen-petaled lotus — [AbhTs 22.34]

children.text: madhyasthanālagumphitasarojayugaghaṭṭanakramādagnau /
children.translated_text: Through the sequence of the collision of the pair of lotuses strung on the central stalk, in the fire,

children.text: madhyasthaśaśadharasundaradinakarakaraughasaṃghaṭṭāt // AbhTs_22.35
children.translated_text: From the collision of the streams of rays of the beautiful moon and sun situated in the center — [AbhTs 22.35]

children.text: tridalāruṇavīryakalāsaṅgān madhye 'ṅkurasṛṣṭiḥ /
children.translated_text: From the connection with the three-petaled red power-<s>kalā</s>, a sprout-creation [arises] in the center;

children.text: iti śaśadharavāsarapaticitraguṣaṃghaṭṭamudrayā jhaṭiti // AbhTs_22.36
children.translated_text: Thus, by the <s>mudrā</s> of the collision of the diverse moon-sun formations, instantly — [AbhTs 22.36]

children.text: sṛṣṭyādikramam antaḥ kurvaṃs turye sthitiṃ labhate /
children.translated_text: Performing the sequence of creation etc. internally, one obtains stability in the fourth (<s>turya</s>);

children.text: etat khecaramudrāveśe 'nyonyaṃ svaśaktiśaktimatoḥ // AbhTs_22.37
children.translated_text: This is the mutual [experience] of <s>Śakti</s> and <s>Śaktimān</s> in the entry into <s>Khecarī mudrā</s>. [AbhTs 22.37]

children.text: pānopabhogalīlāhāsādiṣu yo bhaved vimarśamayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Whatever is of the nature of reflective awareness in drinking, enjoyment, play, laughter, and the like —

children.text: avyaktadhvanirāvasphoṭaśrutinādanādāntaiḥ // AbhTs_22.38
children.translated_text: With the [sounds] ending in <s>nāda</s>: indistinct sound, resonance, burst, <s>śruti</s> (tone), <s>nāda</s> (vibration) — [AbhTs 22.38]

children.text: avyucchinnānāhataparamārthair mantravīryaṃ tat /
children.translated_text: Uninterrupted, <s>anāhata</s> (unstruck), of supreme reality — that is <s>mantra</s>-power;

children.text: gamanāgamaviśrāntiṣu karṇe nayane dvilakṣyasamparke // AbhTs_22.39
children.translated_text: In the resting points of going, coming, and resting, in the ear, in the eye, in the contact of two focal points — [AbhTs 22.39]

children.text: tatsammīlanayoge dehāntākhye ca yāmale cakre /
children.translated_text: In the union of that closing [of the senses], and in the <s>yāmala cakra</s> called the end of the body —

children.text: kucamadhyahṛdayadeśād oṣṭhānte kaṇṭhagaṃ yad avyaktam // AbhTs_22.40
children.translated_text: From the region of the center of the breasts and heart to the end of the lips, that which is indistinct, going to the throat — [AbhTs 22.40]

children.text: tac cakradvayamadhyagam ākarṇya kṣobhavigamasamaye yat /
children.translated_text: Having heard that [sound] situated between the two <s>cakras</s>, at the time when the agitation subsides,

children.text: nirvānti tatra caivaṃ yo 'ṣṭavidho nādabhairavaḥ paramaḥ // AbhTs_22.41
children.translated_text: That which ceases there — that is the eightfold supreme <s>Nāda-Bhairava</s>. [AbhTs 22.41]

children.text: jyotir dhvaniś ca yasmāt sā māntrī vyāptir ucyate paramā /
children.translated_text: Since from it [arise] light and sound, that is called the supreme <s>māntrī</s> (mantra-based) pervasion;

children.text: karmaṇi karmaṇi viduṣaḥ syāj jīvato muktiḥ // AbhTs_22.42
children.translated_text: In every action, for the wise, there is liberation while living (<s>jīvanmukti</s>). [AbhTs 22.42]

children.text: tajjñaḥ śāstre muktaḥ parakulavijñānabhājanaṃ garbhaḥ /
children.translated_text: One who knows that is liberated in the scripture; the receptacle of the knowledge of the supreme <s>Kula</s> is the embryo —

children.text: śūnyāśūnyālayaṃ kuryād ekadaṇḍe 'nalānilau // AbhTs_22.43
children.translated_text: One should make the abode of the void and non-void; in the single staff, [uniting] fire and wind. [AbhTs 22.43]

children.text: śūlaṃ samarasīkṛtya rase rasam iva sthitam /
children.translated_text: Having brought the trident into the state of equal savor (<s>samarasa</s>), established as essence within essence,

children.text: tyaktāśaṅko nirācāro nāham asmīti bhāvayan // AbhTs_22.44
children.translated_text: Free from apprehension, beyond conventional conduct, contemplating 'I am not [a limited self]'— [AbhTs 22.44]

children.text: dehasthā devatāḥ paśyan hlādodvegādi ciddhane /
children.translated_text: Seeing the deities established in the body, [seeing] delight, agitation, and the like as the wealth of consciousness,

children.text: karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam // AbhTs_22.45
children.translated_text: The host of deities stationed in the circles of the ears, eyes, mouth, nose, and so forth— [AbhTs 22.45]

children.text: grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā sidhyati dhruvam // AbhTs_22.47
children.translated_text: Constantly seeing the grasper [of all experience], one surely attains perfection through <s>Khecarī</s> [mudrā]. [AbhTs 22.47]

children.text: śvabhre sudūre jhaṭiti svadehaṃ saṃpātayan vāsam asāhasena /
children.translated_text: Hurling one's own body swiftly into a deep pit far away, or dwelling without haste,

children.text: ākuñcya hastadvitayaṃ prapaśyan mudrām imāṃ vyomacarīṃ bhajeta // AbhTs_22.48
children.translated_text: Contracting both hands and gazing [inward]—one should practice this <s>mudrā</s> called <s>Vyomacarī</s> (Sky-traveler). [AbhTs 22.48]

children.text: ity eṣa yāmalayāgaḥ // AbhTs_22.49
children.translated_text: This is the <s>Yāmala-yāga</s> (paired worship). [AbhTs 22.49]

children.text: uktavyāptike prāṇe viśvamaye proktasaṃvidvyāptyā tarpaṇānnagandhadhūpādisamarpaṇena upodbalanaṃ prāṇayāgaḥ // AbhTs_22.50
children.translated_text: The <s>Prāṇa-yāga</s> (worship through vital breath) consists in the reinforcement of the <s>prāṇa</s>—which has been described as all-pervading—through the offering of satisfaction-oblations (<s>tarpaṇa</s>), food, fragrance, incense, and the like, by means of the pervasion of awareness as previously described. [AbhTs 22.50]

children.text: viśrāntirūḍhis tu saṃvidyāgaḥ prāg eva nirūpitaḥ // AbhTs_22.51
children.translated_text: But the repose that has ascended [to full establishment] is the <s>Saṃvid-yāga</s> (worship through awareness)—that has already been determined. [AbhTs 22.51]

children.text: evam etebhyo yāgebhyo 'nyatamaṃ kṛtvā yadi tathāvidhanirvicikitsatāpacitritahṛdayaḥ śiṣyo bhavati tadā tasmai tadyāgadarśanapūrvakaṃ tilājyāhutipūrvakanirapekṣam eva pūrvoktavyāptyā anusaṃdhānakrameṇa avalokanayā dīkṣāṃ kuryāt parokṣadīkṣādike naimittikānte tu pūrva eva vidhiḥ // AbhTs_22.52
children.translated_text: Thus, having performed any one of these worships, if the disciple becomes one whose heart is adorned with unwavering certainty of that kind, then for him one should perform initiation (<s>dīkṣā</s>) preceded by the showing of that worship, preceded by oblations of sesame and butter, independently [of other rituals], by the sequence of contemplative integration through the pervasion described earlier, by means of the method of direct seeing (<s>avalokanā</s>). But for the distant initiation (<s>parokṣadīkṣā</s>) and the like, at the end of an occasional [rite], the earlier procedure alone applies. [AbhTs 22.52]

children.text: kevalam etad yāgapradhānatayā iti // AbhTs_22.53
children.translated_text: Only [the difference is] that this [procedure] has worship as its primary element. [AbhTs 22.53]

children.text: guruśarīre saptamaḥ kulayāgaḥ sarvottamaḥ so 'pi prāg yāgasāhityena sakṛd eva kṛtaḥ sarvaṃ pūrayati iti śivam // AbhTs_22.54
children.translated_text: The seventh [type], the <s>Kula-yāga</s> (clan worship) in the body of the guru, is the supreme of all. That too, performed but once with the accompaniment of worship as previously [described], fulfills everything. Thus [ends the text with the word] <s>Śivam</s> (auspiciousness). [AbhTs 22.54]
